title: FivePRS asset listing
description: One community asset listed on fiveprs.org/assets.

id.description: Unique id used in the URL, fiveprs.org/assets/<id>. Must match the file name.

summary.description: One or two sentences shown on the listing card.

author.description: Your name or team name as you want it shown.

repository.description: The public GitHub repository the asset is released from, as owner/name.

source.description: open if the repository contains the source code under a license, closed if it only hosts releases.

asset.description: File name of the download attached to each release. A version suffix is allowed: my-pack.zip also matches my-pack-1.2.0.zip. Leave out to link to the releases page.

image.description: A 16:9 preview image hosted on GitHub: raw.githubusercontent.com or github.com/user-attachments.

tags.description: Up to 6 lowercase tags to help people find the asset.

minVersion.description: The oldest FivePRS version the asset works with.
